dct_title_s: Dominica, particulars of three lots of land : in the town of Roseau, with the valuable dwelling-house abd buildings, thereon, forming the premises known as Hillsborough House, also of a piece of land known as Guinea Grass Piece, respectively situate in the town of Dominica : which will be sold by auction, in two lots, by Messrs.
